item.title: Ferguson out of World Cup playoffs
item.description: Republic of Ireland striker Evan Ferguson has been ruled out of the World Cup playoffs later this month. Reports from Italy indicate that the Roma player is due to undergo surgery on a persistent ankle injury in Brighton next week. That could mean Ferguson's season is over, leaving Heimir Hallgrimsson down an attacking option for the play-off semi-final away to Czechia on March 26th. Advertisement

item.title: New deal for Gravenberch
item.description: Liverpool midfielder Ryan Gravenberch has signed a new contract with the club. The Dutch international joined from Bayern Munich in 2023 and has made 123 appearances since. He's signed a new deal to remain on Merseyside until the end of the 2031-32 season. Advertisement

item.title: France beaten by Scotland
item.description: Scotland have kept their rugby union Six Nations title hopes alive with a brilliant 50-40 victory over defending champions France at Murrayfield. The win means they'll go into the final weekend level on points at the top of the table. England are in Rome to take on Italy, as they look to bounce back from consecutive defeats to Scotland and Ireland. Advertisement

item.title: Road re-opened following multi-vehicle crash outside Listowel
item.description: The N69 Tralee to Listowel road has been re-opened following a multi-vehicle crash. Gardaí and Fire services were called to the scene of a five car crash at the Six Crosses on the N69 outside Listowel at around 2.30 this afternoon. The road was blocked and traffic was diverted Advertisement No serious injuries have been reported.

item.title: Kerry County Council says it’s on track to achieve a 50% energy efficiency improvement by 2030
item.description: Kerry County Council says it’s on track to achieve a 50% energy efficiency improvement by 2030. That’s according to information provided at the recent Listowel MD meeting in response to a motion by Cllr Tom Barry. The Sinn Féin councillor asked for the update as part of the upgrading of public lighting systems in the region. item.title: Additional grants available to CE Schemes in the county
item.description: Grants of €1,000 are being made available to Community Employment organisations in the county.
